rejected_derivations.assumption: Every progress record corresponds to a committed candidate attempt
rejected_derivations.reason: Initial ranking checkpoints also occur without a new attempt

rejected_derivations.assumption: Only the initial checkpoint has no committed candidate attempt
rejected_derivations.reason: Feedback-only checkpoints can repeat the current committed-attempt count and best result

repair: Exclude checkpoints with zero new attempts only when their attempted count and selected result equal the preceding committed state. Require exactly four monotone committed-attempt points and a terminal result equal to the original native receipt.
scope: Offline derivation failures and repair only; no model, compiler or generated-body measurement was repeated. First-shot perfection is not acceptance.
